summary: Closed the DX11 session auto-analyzer false-negative gap exposed by the 2026-09-30 Quest 3/VDXR run. The analyzer now counts fallback-cached-image submission windows and per-frame final markers and emits DX11_SUSTAINED_CACHED_IMAGE_FALLBACK_CONFIRMED for backend=dx11 when one summarized fallback window reaches 300 frames or when 120 final fallback markers are observed. Added a synthetic 2x450-frame failure case plus direct-gpu control and wired the regression test into Backend Conversion Gate. This does not change the renderer/runtime path and does not fix the brown menu rectangle itself.
